title: The future of coding isn't one AI assistant. It's a team of AI agents working together.
description:
Instead of handling every task yourself, modern AI systems can split complex projects into specialized jobs—planning architecture, writing code, building interfaces, testing implementations, and reviewing results in parallel.

The biggest productivity upgrade isn't a smarter chatbot.

It's better coordination.

The developers who win won't be the ones writing the most code.

They'll be the ones orchestrating the best AI workflows.
